summary: Backend regression suite for camera upload, quoted+photo unpaid billing, owner transaction statuses, and 14-day stale-request auto-cancel passed (4/4). Frontend mobile retest passed for Pegawai Kurir->Timbang camera entry/state, camera close action, customer Bayar rincian+photo visibility without Setujui Nota, owner Laporan Transaksi detail open, and kurir request-date/detail interactions.
action_items: Optional hardening: align frontend env handling with platform contract by supporting EXPO_BACKEND_URL fallback in src/api.ts and src/photos.ts.
Keep QRIS settlement flow unchanged in this scope because it is MOCKED/manual by product design.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/api.ts and frontend/src/photos.ts depend on EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL only; add EXPO_BACKEND_URL fallback to match deployment contract and reduce env regression risk.
Expo log shows non-blocking React Native DevTools install warning (Electron root/no-sandbox) during startup; app runtime flow still works in web preview.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary UI seed orders via /app/tests/iter15_ui_data_setup.py and removed them via /app/tests/iter15_ui_data_cleanup.py. No TEST_ records from this iteration intentionally retained.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Camera regression is now reproducible as fixed: photo-camera appears immediately on Timbang before service categories rendered (observed category count 0 when button already visible), opens CameraCapture state, and closes safely.
rca_of_issue: Previous failure was likely UI placement/visibility timing of the photo section under long content. In this iteration, photo-camera is visible immediately after Timbang load and camera modal opens reliably, indicating the relocation fix addressed the prior DOM reachability issue.
